features: Lightning-Fast Performance – Experience read speeds up to 100 MB/s with C10, U3, V30, and A1 speed class ratings, enabling seamless 4K RAW video recording, rapid app loading, and quick file transfers that keep pace with your busy lifestyle.

Universal Device Compatibility – Works flawlessly with smartphones, tablets, laptops, action cameras, dash cams, drones, and all microSD-enabled devices; move your content effortlessly across multiple platforms for maximum flexibility.

Military-Grade Durability – Built to withstand extreme conditions with shock-proof, dust-proof, X-ray-proof construction; operates reliably in temperatures from 0°C to +70°C, protecting your precious memories even in harsh environments.

Perfect Capacity for Every Need – Choose from 32GB, 64GB, 128GB, or 256GB options to match your exact storage requirements; whether capturing life's moments in ultra-high definition or managing extensive digital libraries, there's a perfect size for you.

Trusted Quality & Peace of Mind – Backed by Acer's trusted brand reputation with 5-year limited warranty and comprehensive certifications (CE, FCC, RoHS); manufactured by BIWIN Storage Technology, a leading flash memory specialist.
